checks.transcription: Ah, perfect timing. We've got the whole family together, and I've been looking forward to this all evening. Come on, grab a seat.
Well, that was quite the evening. Some very clever moves all around, I must say. I think I'll need a little practice before our next game night.
Oh, wonderful! Everyone's arriving, and the house is looking absolutely splendid! I do hope you've brought your appetite, kiddo. Your other mother has been cooking all day!
I've been having the most interesting conversations this evening. Well, I think they were interesting. There was rather a lot going on.
Ah, a little friendly competition. Nothing like a good board game to bring people together. Though I do hope nobody gets too competitive.
Mmm. This is marvelous. I was beginning to think we'd never get to eat. Though I suppose that is what happens when you invite the whole neighborhood.
Ah, what a splendid party! I don't think I've talked that much in ages. I may need a nice quiet evening at the piano after all this.
Oh, wonderful, the guest of honor. Welcome to your very own party, kiddo. I must say, the whole house is looking rather splendid.
I've been talking to all sorts of wonderful people tonight. Mind you, I seem to have forgotten half their names already. Ha ha!
Oh, there are some marvelous surprises tucked away around the house tonight. Your other mother really has outdone herself.
Well, would you look at that cake? Absolutely magnificent, and so many presents too. I think you've got quite a bit of unwrapping ahead of you.
Ah, what a wonderful party. Lovely people, marvelous entertainment. And that cake was absolutely delicious. We really ought to do this again.
Well, kiddo, I hope you've enjoyed yourself. It is not every day you get a celebration quite like this one. Your other mother certainly knows how to make things special.
Ah, your other mother has popped out, has she? Well, she has always got a hundred little things to attend to. Don't mind me, kiddo. I'll be at the piano if you need anything.
Oh, she has gone out for a while? Yes, she does that from time to time. I couldn't tell you exactly where she goes, though. She rather likes to keep certain things to herself.
When will she be back? Oh, goodness! I haven't the faintest idea. She tends to return whenever she is finished whatever it is she is doing. Best not to worry about it.
Ah, well your other mother can be rather unpredictable about these things. Sometimes she is back before I've even finished a piece of music. Other times I have time to play the whole thing. Twice.

note: ASR checks words, not acting. Human listening review is not replaced by these checks.
